note: Hand fixes to the road of data/road.json (tools/realroad.mjs merges them), from the owner's Street View walk-through. drop: OSM features that are not for us (within 8 m); add: ones the map lacks. roundabouts: by OSM way id, the island's look (deco grass|bushes|trees|none, kerb concrete|brick). stretches: from-to metres with rw (half the asphalt), sw (sidewalk or verge), town, lines:false, dual (a one-way carriageway, the other beyond a median this wide), lot (bays at right angles on the left: from, pitch, aisle, bed), edge {L,R: hedge|wall|reeds}, park [L,R] (cars at the kerb), trucks, trees [L,R], open (no street wall pulled to the sidewalk), roles (the only generic pictures there, e.g. industrial). props: code-drawn things (mast, bollard, rubbish) at, or from-to every. noTowers: no tower blocks in the kit.
